Owned 0x4b5300 calls owned 0x4b5340 first. Every normal return from 0x4b5340 unconditionally clears receiver+0x1c at 0x4b53d1, after its last outside call at 0x4b53c8. Thus the immediately following null test at 0x4b530d always skips these five bytes under the declared ABI. Ownership and translation are retained.
